purpose: Kashmiri Perso-Arabic fluency-corpus candidates; not English-Kashmiri parallel data

cautions: Web crawl text, not reviewed Kashmiri or aligned translation pairs
Check original-page rights, privacy and content quality before commercial model training
The test split must not enter training
The checked file is FineWeb2-derived and overlaps the FineWeb2 Kashmiri slice
Custom license and upstream rights must be resolved before training or redistribution
Use only keep files if access and rights are cleared; remove and statistics files are not training text

overlapCheck.method: Exact Unicode string comparison of the first 100 FineWeb2 viewer rows against the DCAD kas_Arab/fineweb-2_000001_keep.jsonl text field

decision: Record as separate monolingual fluency candidates only. Do not add to approved English-Kashmiri sentence pairs or production training until rights, overlap and language quality are checked.
